status_policy.verified_local: Narrow requirement supported by identified source/independent arithmetic and/or actual coordinator browser evidence. Teaching-source verification is not learner completion. This does not imply all-app readiness, accessibility, native-device testing or publication.
status_policy.implemented_pending_verification: Correction or task path implemented; required acceptance evidence remains incomplete. Not closed.
status_policy.open: Required actual human verification not performed; preparatory source/protocols do not close it.

summary.publication: Exact pushed-SHA workflows and actual live follow-ups are tracked separately in publication.json. This index records local requirement verification and does not infer publication of a later source checkpoint.
summary.human_gates: Actual screen-reader and uncoached novice evidence remains open. Authored synthetic input events/font doubling do not replace native picker, device zoom or human tasks.
